description: All hand-in assignments with their window, status (AANKOMEND, IN_TE_LEVEREN, IN_AFWACHTING, AKKOORD), teLaat (boolean when the item has a hand-in window: true only if a digital hand-in was required, the deadline has passed and nothing was submitted; false for paper/in-class items with inleveringenVerwacht 0 or missing — also flagged geenDigitaleInlevering; omitted when there is no hand-in window), description, attachments and links. status=open keeps upcoming and to-do ones, and by default hides past-due items where no digital hand-in is expected (inleveringenVerwacht 0 or missing, e.g. on paper; count in verborgenZonderInlevering); includeNoHandIn=true keeps them. Near-duplicates (same subject, topic, window and status, e.g. published to two groups) are merged by default, with the other ids in duplicaatToekenningIds; dedupe=false lists them separately. Use toekenningId with assignment_detail. Every item lists bijlagen (fileUrl and/or bestanddataId for download_attachment) and externeMaterialen; empty means the teacher attached nothing (lesmateriaal=true is only a flag, there is no separate material call).

dedupe.description: Merge near-duplicate assignments (same subject, topic, window, status). Default true.

includeNoHandIn.description: With status=open: also show past-due items without a digital hand-in (inleveringenVerwacht 0 or missing). Default false.

leerlingId.description: Numeric leerling id. Required when more than one child is linked.

name: assignments
title: Assignments (hand-ins)
